add_library(ws2812
Neopixel.cpp
)
pico_generate_pio_header(ws2812 ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/ws2812.pio)
target_include_directories(ws2812 PUBLIC
.
${PROTO_OUTPUT_DIR}
)
target_link_libraries(ws2812
pico_stdlib
hardware_pio
hardware_clocks
nanopb
)

# Neopixel.h includes enums.pb.h, generated by the proto step
if(TARGET generate_proto)
  add_dependencies(ws2812 generate_proto)
endif()
